title: Conditional coordinate trace contractions for ordinary etale pushforward
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $f:X\to Y$ a proper morphism of arbitrary schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-pc-scheme], and $W=X\times_YX$ with projections $p_1,p_2$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Use ordinary unbounded small-etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], exact inverse images [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], derived tensors [def-kun-derived-tensor], and their canonical derived adjunctions. Let $J_Y$ be an $A_Y$-module sheaf etale locally isomorphic to $A_Y$, let $d\in\mathbf Z$, and set $L_Y=J_Y[2d]$, $L_X=f^*L_Y$, and $L_W=p_1^*L_X=p_2^*L_X$, using the canonical pullback comparisons. Let $F=Rf_*$ and $HK=f^*K\otimes_A^L L_X$.

Write $\pi_{u,K,E}:K\otimes_A^LRu_*E\to Ru_*(u^*K\otimes_A^LE)$ for the ordered canonical projection map: it is the symmetry-conjugate of [def-kun-projection-formula-map]. Let $\beta_{2,M}:f^*FM\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_{2*}p_1^*M$ and $\beta_{1,M}:f^*FM\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_{1*}p_2^*M$ be the canonical proper exchanges [def-kun-unbounded-exchange]. Suppose given derived morphisms $t:FL_X\to A_Y$ and $t_i:Rp_{i*}L_W\to A_X$ with
$$t_i\circ\beta_{i,L_X}=f^*t\qquad(i=1,2),$$
under $p_{3-i}^*L_X=L_W$ and $f^*A_Y=A_X$. No diagonal class or diagonal-integral identity is assumed. Define natural maps
$$e_K=(1_K\otimes t)\circ\pi_{f,K,L_X}^{-1}:FHK\to K,$$
with the right unitor understood, and
$$C_M:Rp_{2*}(p_1^*M\otimes L_W)\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_{2*}p_1^*M\otimes L_X\xrightarrow{\beta_{2,M}^{-1}\otimes1}HFM.$$
The first arrow is the inverse projection formula for $p_2$ with outside coefficient $L_X$, conjugated by tensor symmetries. Then for every $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ one has
$$e_{FM}\circ F(C_M)=F(1_M\otimes t_1)\circ F(\pi_{p_1,M,L_W}^{-1}),$$
where the two sources are identified by $FRp_{2*}=R(fp_2)_*=R(fp_1)_*=FRp_{1*}$, and
$$H(e_K)\circ C_{HK}=(1_{HK}\otimes t_2)\circ\pi_{p_2,HK,L_W}^{-1}.$$
In the second formula identify $p_1^*HK=p_2^*HK$ by $fp_1=fp_2$. All comparisons are the canonical tensor, pullback, direct-image composition and exchange comparisons; the maps are equal as derived morphisms. No Noetherian, boundedness, constructibility, or Tor-amplitude hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: First triangle, the paragraph interchanging the two coordinates; second triangle, taking the common pulled-back coefficient outside the second projection. Conditional comparison of the actual exchange/projection maps, before evaluating either diagonal integral.

proof.text: For the first equation fix M. Precompose both sides with the isomorphism J=orderedProjection(f,FM,f*L) followed by F(comparison(L,M) inverse). Apply [lem-sfb-etale-coordinate-kunneth-factorization] to J followed by directComparison. On the left cancel comparison inverse/hom and the f projection hom/inverse in evaluation. On the right cancel the p1 projection hom/inverse and combine tensor maps, replacing exchange1 followed by t1 using ht1. Apply [lem-sfb-etale-projection-trace-normalization] to identify the remaining composite with identity tensor t followed by the right unitor. Cancel J to obtain the first equation. The cancellations are implemented in the proved private generic lemma cancel_coordinate and instantiated with the canonical isomorphisms; the trace substitution uses projectionTraceNormalization and tensor functoriality.

source.place: The two triangle computations before the diagonal integrals, coordinate interchange and extraction of the common coefficient.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-etale-even-line-self-symmetry] to J[2d]. Use its equality as the self-symmetry hypothesis in [lem-sfb-etale-second-coordinate-contraction] with the given ht2. This is exactly the second equation for the unchanged canonical maps. Pair the two conclusions.

Lean reduction: the first equation is proved by isomorphism cancellation and projection naturality; the second specializes a coefficient self-symmetry theorem.
